title: CAD IR Phase 16 — 3D-print specific rules
summary: Implementation plan for two new CAD IR manufacturing validation rules (print-3d-min-wall and print-3d-bed-size) that fire when process is print_3d.
notes: Plan-shaped doc under docs/superpowers/plans/ but contains technical contracts (rule IDs, function signatures, per-material thresholds, default bed dimensions, severity levels) that act as implementation specifications. Classified SPEC over DOC because it defines binding technical constraints; not ADR (no Decision/Consequences trade-off framing); not PRD (no user stories or business requirements).
